summary: YouTube posted its official launch note for YouTube Shopping in Saudi Arabia, the UAE and Egypt, with Amazon as the launch retailer (first reported yesterday).
Amazon shared a roundup of its Q3 2026 announcements ahead of earnings, with no new Associates or OneLink news.
LTK hosted 13 UK creator-founders in London with co-founder Amber Venz Box, a sign it is courting UK creators.
Lasso, URLgenius and Button/Posttap were quiet.

items.title: Some of Amazon's Q3 2026 announcements, from new devices to AI breakthroughs
items.why: A company-wide roundup of devices and AI news, not an affiliate update. Worth a skim for anything that changes how shoppers find products.

items.title: Watch It, Love It, Buy It: YouTube Shopping Arrives in the Middle East
items.why: YouTube keeps adding countries where creators earn from built-in product tags. Each new market grows the share of creator shopping that stays inside YouTube.
